title: Data Processing: Dataflow & Dataproc — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Visualizes Unified Data Processing Architecture: Cloud Dataflow (Apache Beam, Streaming Engine, auto-scaling) vs Cloud Dataproc (Managed Spark/Hadoop, Ephemeral clusters, Cloud Storage connector).
routing_rationale: Data processing architecture divides into serverless unified stream/batch (Cloud Dataflow with Apache Beam) vs open-source ecosystem compatibility (Cloud Dataproc running native Apache Spark, Hive, and Presto on ephemeral compute).

nodes.label: Real-Time Event Stream
nodes.detail: Continuous clickstream and IoT telemetry requiring sub-second windowed processing.

nodes.label: Historical Parquet Files
nodes.detail: Nightly batch logs stored in GCS buckets ready for ETL aggregation.

nodes.label: Dataflow Streaming Engine
nodes.detail: Offloads state to dedicated backend; auto-scales worker fleet based on watermark lag.

nodes.label: Dataproc Ephemeral Cluster
nodes.detail: Spins up 100 Spot VM workers; runs 45-minute Spark job; auto-terminates upon completion.

nodes.label: BigQuery Storage Write API
nodes.detail: Direct streaming ingestion into partitioned tables with exactly-once delivery.

steps.title: Serverless Streaming & Ephemeral Batch Ingestion
steps.action: Pub/Sub streams into Dataflow; Dataproc reads historical Parquet from GCS.
steps.why_traversal: Applies the optimal compute runtime to each workload type.

steps.title: Unified Analytics Delivery
steps.action: Both pipelines persist transformed records into BigQuery tables with zero data duplication.
steps.why_traversal: Creates unified analytical layer supporting real-time operational BI and historical reporting.

scenarios.label: Dataproc Spot VM Eviction Outage
scenarios.root_cause: Dataproc cluster configured with 100% Spot VMs including master node; Google reclaimed master.
scenarios.diverted_path: Cluster crashed mid-job; entire 4-hour batch job failed.
scenarios.recovery: Configure standard persistent VMs for master and primary workers; use Spot VMs strictly for secondary task workers.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
